title: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HEALTH FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1995
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑‑(1) This
Ordinance may be called the North‑West Frontier Province Health
Foundation Ordinance, 1995.
(2) It extends to whole of the North‑West
Frontier Province.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Establishment of the foundations

ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HEALTH FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1995
3. Establishment of the Foundation.‑‑‑(1) Government shall,
by notification in the official Gazette, establish a Foundation for the North‑West
Frontier Province.
(2) The Foundation shall be a
body corporate, having perpetual succession and a common seal with powers to
acquire, hold and dispose of property, both movable and immovable, and shall,
by the said name sue and be sued.
(3) The Head Office of the
Foundation shall be at Peshawar.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Board of directors

ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HEALTH FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1995
4. Board of
Directors.‑‑(1) As soon as may be, but not later than two
months, from the date of commencement of this Ordinance, Government shall
constitute the Board of Directors consisting of the following‑‑
(i) the Chief Minister of the North‑West
Frontier Province;
(ii) the Minister for Health, North‑West
Frontier Province;
(iii) Additional Chief Secretary, Government of the
North‑West Frontier Province;
(iv) Secretary to Government of
the North‑West Frontier 'Province, Finance Department;
(v) Secretary to Government of the North West
Frontier Province, Health Department;
(vi) Secretary to Government of the North West
Frontier Province, Services and General Administration Department;
(vii) Director General Health Services of the
Government of Pakistan, Ministry of Health;
(viii) five nominees of the Chief Minister from
private sector and non -Government Organizations/Autonomous Institutes; and
(ix) Managing Director of the
Foundation.
(2) The Chief Minister shall be the Chairman of the
Board and the Minister for Health shall be the Vice‑Chairman.
(3) The Managing Director shall
also act as Secretary to the Board.
(4) The nominated Directors
shall serve during the pleasure of the Government for a term not exceeding
three years.
(5) Notwithstanding the provisions contained in
subsection (4), or subsection (2) of section 6, the Board may remove a Director
or the Managing Director, as the case may be, on the grounds of inefficiency,
misconduct, mental or physical infirmity after giving him an opportunity of
personal hearing.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Management

ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HEALTH FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1995
5. Management.‑The administration, management
and general control of the Foundation and its affairs shall vest in the Board,
which may exercise all powers and do all acts and things that may be exercised
or done by the Foundation.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Managing director

ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HEALTH FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1995
6. Managing Director.‑‑(1) Government
shall appoint a Managing Director on such terms and conditions as it may
determine.
(2) The Managing Director shall serve during the
pleasure of the Government for a term upto three years which may further be
extended for a period not exceeding two years.
(3) the Managing Director shall be the Chief
Executive of the Foundation and shall perform such functions as may be
prescribed or assigned to him by the Board.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Secretary

ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HEALTH FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1995
7. Secretary.‑(1)
The Managing Director, while acting as Secretary to the Board, shall be
responsible for:‑‑
(i) convening the meetings of the Board;
(ii) the preparation of the agenda, working paper and
its distribution among the Directors;
(iii) recording the minutes of each meeting of the
Board and its prompt despatch to the concerned quarters;
(iv) proper follow‑up of all matters connected
with or arising out of a meeting of the Board; and
(v) monitoring and evaluation of the progress of
projects approved by the Board.
(2) The Managing Director shall be responsible for
any other task given to him by the Board from time to time.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Committee

ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HEALTH FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1995
8. Committee.‑‑The Board may constitute
such financial, technical, advisory or any other committee as may be deemed
necessary for carrying out the functions of the Foundation or the Board under
this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Appointment of officers etc

ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HEALTH FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1995
9. Appointment of
officers, etc.‑‑The Foundation may employ such officers, advisors,
consultants and other employees, as may be necessary for the efficient
performance of its functions, subject to such rules as may be prescribed:
provided that no appointment as Advisors and Consultants shall be made without
prior approval of the Board.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Delegation of powers

ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HEALTH FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1995
10. Delegation of powers.‑‑The Board may
delegate to any officer, authority or employee of the Foundation any of its
powers, duties or functions under this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Business of the board

ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HEALTH FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1995
11. Business of the Board.‑‑(1) The
meetings and the business of the Board shall be conducted in such manner and
according to such procedure, as may be prescribed, and, until so prescribed, as
may be determined by the Board.
(2) No act or proceedings of the Board shall be
invalid merely on the ground of the existence of any vacancy in, or any defect
in the constitution of, the Board.
(3) The quorum necessary for transacting business at
a meeting shall be one half of the total membership of the Board, a fraction
being counted as one.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Functions of the foundation

ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HEALTH FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1995
12. Functions of the Foundation.‑‑(1)
Subject to approval of Government, the Foundation shall take all such measures
as it deems necessary for the development, promotion and financing of health
institutions in private sector catering to the needs of basic health services
in line with the health policy of the Government.
(2) Without prejudice to the generality of the
functions mentioned in subsection (1), the Foundation may,‑‑
(a) establish or cause to be established institutions
for needs of basic health services duly approved by the technical, financial or
any other committee as the Board may constitute;
(b) subject to such standard as laid down by
Government, give loans and grants to private organizations and individuals, on
such terms and conditions as may be approved by the Board, for establishing or
taking over operation of such basic health units and ether rural and urban health facilities as Government may, from time to
time, specify;
(c) take appropriate measures for integration,
coordination, consolidation and monitoring of privately managed health
institutions assisted by the Foundation to ensure the quality and standard of
health services in private sector;
(d) take measures to promote, develop and finance
health institutions in health deficient areas, priority being given to
diagnostic and clinical facilities in primary and secondary health Sectors and
facilities of mother and child health care; and
(e) perform such other functions as may be assigned
to it by the Government.
(3) The Foundation may, with prior approval of
Government, and subject to any other law for the time being in force, approach
national and international agencies for loans, grants and project assistance
required for promoting and financing of health facilities to the people.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Power to impose conditions

ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HEALTH FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1995
13. Powers to impose conditions.‑‑(1)
While giving loans or making grants under this Ordinance the Board may impose
such conditions or execute such agreements as it may consider necessary or
expedient for protecting its interest and securing that the loan or grant is
put to such use by the borrower or grantee for which it was advanced or
granted.
(2) Any condition imposed under subsection (1) shall
be valid and shall, notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the
time being in force, be enforceable.
(3) Where a borrower, who is under a liability to pay
back the loan to the Board, makes any default in repayment or otherwise fails
to comply with any of the conditions or terms of agreement so imposed or
executed, then notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained, the Board
shall forthwith recover the loan as arrears of land revenue.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Foundation fund

ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HEALTH FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1995
14. Foundation Fund.‑‑(1) There shall be
a fund to be known as the "Foundation Fund" which shall vest in the
Foundation and to which shall be credited,‑‑
(a) grants made by Government including the Federal
Government;
(b) income from investments made by the Foundation
and recoveries of loans;
(c) donations and endowments;
(d) grants made by the local
bodies; and
(e) all other sums and incomes received by the
Foundation from other sources.
(2) The Fund shall be kept in such custody and shall
be utilized and regulated under the over all supervision of Government in such
manner as may be prescribed.
(3) The Foundation may invest such moneys as are not
required‑ for immediate expenditure in Government saving schemes or in
fixed deposit with the Banks approved by Government.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Budget audit and accounts

ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HEALTH FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1995
15. Budget, audit and accounts.‑‑The
Budget of the Foundation shall be approved and its accounts shall be maintained
and audited in such manner as may be prescribed.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Health Foundation Ordinance 1995
sections.description:
Rules

ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
ORDINANCE IV OF 1995
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE HEALTH FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 1995
16. Rules.‑‑The Board may, with the
approval of Government, make rules for carrying out the purposes of this
Ordinance.
